verdict.rationale: The only startup-latency evidence is the template docs' qualitative claim that pre-built templates give sandboxes "ready to use with zero wait time," which suggests fast startup but gives no documented cold-start timing. The Firecracker microVM mention concerns isolation, not measured start latency. Missing for 10: documented cold-start latency figures (sub-second or few-second numbers), benchmarks or independent/hands-on measurements, and distinction between cold starts and template/snapshot warm starts.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start sandboxes with documented sub-second-to-few-second cold starts

citations.quote: This gives you fully configured sandboxes with running processes ready to use with zero wait time for your users.
